q: How do Fisch trading values actually work?
a: There is no single official value list. The community runs three parallel systems: the Proto spreadsheet (point-based), the TrueVal Discord list and Trade Hub market data (both S$-denominated). The same boat can differ 30% or more between systems, so always confirm which list a number comes from. Our value list cross-checks all three weekly and shows the spread as a range.

q: What's the most valuable mutation in Fisch?
a: Aether at 12× sell value, followed by Fury (11.7×) and Hades' Curse (11.1×). A fish carries one mutation at a time, but attributes like Shiny and Sparkling stack on top of the mutation multiplier — see our Mutations page for all 325 multipliers.

q: Why do Fisch codes expire so fast?
a: Fisch uses a flash-code pattern: most codes drop with weekly updates and expire within 24-48 hours (sometimes same-day). Only a few long-term codes stay live for months. If you keep missing them, check codes right after each weekly update lands — that's when new ones appear.

q: Where do I redeem Fisch codes?
a: In-game, open the settings/menu and look for the code redemption field. Note that many flash codes carry a level requirement (often Level 25+), so brand-new accounts may not be able to claim them.

q: What is appraisal and is it worth it?
a: Appraisal rerolls a fish's mutation and attributes for a fee. Attributes like Shiny and Sparkling can't be lost during appraisal, which makes stacking attributes on a high-multiplier mutation the main way to build extremely valuable fish. The Appraiser's Luck gamepass raises mutation odds.
